verified_facts.text: The resort is located on the banks of the Mae Ping River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the banks of the Mae Ping River, Anantara Chiang Mai Resort opens doors to a world of discovery.

verified_facts.text: The resort is a short tuk tuk ride from Chiang Mai's Old Town and is hidden behind a bamboo wall.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s just a short tuk tuk ride from Chiang Mai’s Old Town to this gorgeous urban resort that’s hidden behind a bamboo wall.

verified_facts.text: The complex was designed by the late Australian architect Kerry Hill.
verified_facts.excerpt: The complex was designed by the late Australian architect Kerry Hill, who specialized in creating visually striking hotels in tropical destinations.

verified_facts.text: The resort centres on the 1921 House, the former British consulate, built over a century ago.
verified_facts.excerpt: centred around the magnificent 1921 House, formerly the British consulate and built over a century ago.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served each day on the verandah of the 1921 House.
verified_facts.excerpt: Here, afternoon tea is served on the verandah each day

verified_facts.text: Daily river cruises depart from the resort's private pier.
verified_facts.excerpt: Daily river cruises departing from the resort’s private pier

verified_facts.text: Deluxe rooms have floor-to-ceiling sliding doors and a daybed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Slide open floor-to-ceiling doors and lounge on your daybed with tranquil views.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe rooms have a balcony or terrace overlooking the garden or river.
verified_facts.excerpt: Balcony or terrace overlooking garden or river

verified_facts.text: Pool Suites have a private plunge pool and a cabana, with privileges that include in-suite check-in and a floating breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a private plunge pool and breezy cabana to enjoy, and privileges that include an in-suite check-in and floating breakfast.

verified_facts.text: Serviced suites, suited to long stays and families, are across the road, linked by a walkway, with full use of the resort's services and facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serviced suites are ideal for long-term stays and families. Located across the road and linked by a walkway, guests enjoy all the services and facilities of the resort.

verified_facts.text: Serviced suites have a kitchen, laundry, and dining, living and work spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kitchen, laundry, dining, living and work spaces

verified_facts.text: Anantara Spa offers daily wellness activities, traditional Thai healing and IV drips.
verified_facts.excerpt: tranquil living awaits, with daily wellness activities, traditional Thai healing and IV drips at Anantara Spa

verified_facts.text: The spa offers a mix of Lanna-inspired rituals and Western treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spa, which offers a mix of Lanna-inspired rituals and Western treatments

verified_facts.text: The infinity pool is surrounded by lily ponds and loungers and overlooks the river.
verified_facts.excerpt: a swim in the 112-foot infinity pool, which is surrounded by lily ponds and loungers, and overlooks the river.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers muay Thai and Spice Spoons cooking classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: immersions in the local culture with muay Thai and Spice Spoons cooking classes.

verified_facts.text: A Street Wise Guru can lead insider tours of lesser-known markets and temples, traditional coffee houses and street food stalls.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dedicated Street Wise Guru can lead you on insider tours of lesser-known markets and temples, traditional coffee houses, street food stalls, and more.

verified_facts.text: All accommodations have large terraces furnished with daybeds.
verified_facts.excerpt: all accommodations have super-sized terraces furnished with cushy daybeds

verified_facts.text: The resort is 4.5 km from Chiang Mai International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anantara Chiang Mai resort is 4.5 km from Chiang Mai international airport.

verified_facts.text: There is no Kids Club, but activities are offered for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: We do not have a Kids Club but we do offer activities available for children.

verified_facts.text: There are no connecting rooms, but guests may request adjoining rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: We do not have connecting rooms but guests may request adjoining rooms.

verified_facts.text: Extra beds are not provided in Deluxe Room categories; they can be requested in Kasara Suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: We do not provide an extra bed in our Deluxe Room categories due to safety regulations. Extra beds can be requested in Kasara Suites.

verified_facts.text: Several of the city's markets are nearby, including the Saturday and Sunday Markets and the Chiang Mai Night Bazaar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Also nearby are several of the bustling markets that the city is known for, from the Saturday and Sunday Markets to the Chiang Mai Night Bazaar.

verified_facts.text: Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wi-Fi is fast and complimentary throughout the resort.
